crossRefs.note: But in my adversity, they rejoiced, and gathered themselves together. The attackers gathered themselves together…
“In that day,” says Yahweh, “I will assemble that which is lame, and I will gather that which is driven away, and that…
and I will make that which was lame a remnant, and that which was cast far off a strong nation: and Yahweh will reign…
I am in pain and bowed down greatly. I go mourning all day long.
I am weary with my groaning. Every night I flood my bed. I drench my couch with my tears.
In the day of my trouble I sought the Lord. My hand was stretched out in the night, and didn’t get tired. My soul…
I remember God, and I groan. I complain, and my spirit is overwhelmed.
He was despised and rejected by men, a man of suffering and acquainted with disease. He was despised as one from whom…

translations.web: For I am ready to fall. My pain is continually before me.
translations.bsb: For I am ready to fall, and my pain is ever with me.
translations.kjv: For I am ready to halt, and my sorrow is continually
translations.asv: For I am ready to fall, And my sorrow is continually before me.
